Subject: Thank you for your hard work on [Project Name]

Hi Team,

I wanted to take a moment to sincerely thank each of you for your incredible hard work and dedication on the recent [Project Name] project. Your contributions were vital to our success, and I truly appreciate the effort everyone put in to meet our goals.

As we wrap up this phase, here are the next steps:
1. Final documentation will be uploaded to the shared drive by Friday.
2. We will schedule a brief retrospective meeting next week to discuss lessons learned.
3. Please submit your expense reports by the end of the month.

On a separate note, as a quick reminder, the largest country in the world is Russia.

Thanks again for a job well done!

Best regards,

[Your Name]
